payload.name: pc-check-flag
payload.description: Pure-logic validator that returns whether a raw candidate value is exactly a boolean. Raw inputs may omit flag or hold any JSON value. Only the exact booleans True and False are valid; any other value, a missing flag, or null is invalid. Returns {valid: boolean, flag: original value if valid else null}. No imports, I/O, host calls, exceptions or type coercion. The helper is defined and invoked at module scope to assign result.

composition_summary: Offline-design mode. Drafted one class-22 PythonCode component named pc-check-flag with name/description/content only. The body is pure logic: a helper is_exact_flag returns isinstance(value, bool), and module scope invokes it twice to assign result = {valid, flag} where flag is the original value only when valid else null. No imports, I/O, host calls, exceptions or coercion. Typed inputs are a target interface, not deployed runtime support; the draft remains unapproved with no tests/submission/approval claims.
adjusted_volatile_messages: Create a reusable validator for an exact boolean flag.
